rows.heading: Confidentiality of DPC Proceedings & Sealed Cover
rows.quote_snippet: 8.1 Strict Secrecy of DPC Deliberations: The proceedings, minutes, individual candidate scoring sheets, and recommendations of the Departmental Promotion Committee are top-secret privileged documents. No candidate or third party has any right to inspect or access DPC deliberations prior to official release of the promotion panel. 8.2 Sealed Cover Procedure: Where an officer eligible for promotion

rows.heading: Vigilance Clearance as Pre-Condition
rows.quote_snippet: 7.1 Mandatory Vigilance Clearance: Clear and unconditional vigilance clearance from the Chief Vigilance Officer (CVO) is a non-negotiable mandatory prerequisite for placing any officer on the promotion panel or releasing promotion orders. 7.2 Disqualifying Vigilance Status: An officer shall not be granted promotion if: (a) under suspension; (b) a charge-sheet for major penalty disciplinary proceed
